title: Minceraft Title Screen
description: Changes the minecraft title to Minceraft because why not (also adds a few splash messages)
body:
This just changes the Title in the main minecraft menu to "Minceraft"

It also adds a few splash messages but that isn't important

(Icon Image is from this post: [https://x.com/FactsBlock/status/1643614283320705032](https://x.com/FactsBlock/status/1643614283320705032))
